snippet.title: Fear Academy Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Fear Academy on steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297940/Fear_Academy/

Fear Academy is a psychological horror game where you traverse a haunted high school. Do your best to avoid the possessed janitor and solve the mystery.
